decision_cruda.rationale: Both failures are confirmed by radio and CMMS. Repairs are likely at 13:30 for LH-01 and 14:30 for LH-02. Central is truck-limited (inflow 124 t/h against 91 t/h of truck capacity), so covering C512-04 adds almost nothing. Este has spare truck capacity (inflow 36 against 72) and E595-06 is 15.4 g/t with 256 t, about 127 oz. Moving LH-08 from the cheap preparation heading (1.9 oz/h) takes 0.53 h. It loads about 30 t/h, roughly 20 oz per hour of loading against 1.9 oz per hour of lost development. The critical-path LH-09 stays put. LH-10 comes out of maintenance at 11:00 and can be reassessed then.
